reference_sql:
WITH paid AS (  -- one row per payment that was not refunded
  SELECT u.user_id,
         CAST(date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
         date_diff('month', date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts), date_trunc('month', p.paid_at)) AS month_offset
  FROM payments p
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  JOIN signups u ON u.user_id = s.user_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
    AND u.signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND u.signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-04-01 00:00:00+00'
)
SELECT cohort_month, month_offset, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS paying_users
FROM paid
GROUP BY cohort_month, month_offset
alternatives:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
       date_diff('month', u.signup_ts, p.paid_at) AS month_offset,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS paying_users
FROM signups u
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
WHERE p.refunded = false
  AND u.signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND u.signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-04-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
       (year(p.paid_at) * 12 + month(p.paid_at)) - (year(u.signup_ts) * 12 + month(u.signup_ts)) AS month_offset,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS paying_users
FROM signups u
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
WHERE NOT p.refunded
  AND u.signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND u.signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-04-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY 1, 2

solver.query:
WITH coh AS (
  SELECT user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-04-01 00:00:00+00'
),
pm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', p.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS pay_month
  FROM payments p
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
)
SELECT c.cohort_month,
       date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, pm.pay_month) AS month_offset,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS paying_users
FROM coh c
JOIN pm ON pm.user_id = c.user_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
